title: Travel Loyalty Login
scenario: A points blog comment links to a bonus tracker requiring your airline login.

answers.A: Open the airline loyalty account directly and check offers there.
answers.B: Enter your airline login into the third-party tracker.
answers.C: Use the tracker with a password you do not use anywhere else.
answers.D: Ignore the tracker and use the airline official support route.

explanation: A points tracker does not need your airline password. Third-party bonus promises are a common route to credential theft.
proTip: Keep loyalty credentials inside the loyalty programme.
